summary: Trivia Game (Games Hub) verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing — catalog returns 7 categories + 4 difficulties (easy/moderate/hard/nightmare) with points 5/10/20/35; /daily returns 10 questions with deterministic ids; start session and GET DO NOT leak the answer/explain fields; answer endpoint returns correct=true with score increment when picked==answer, correct=false on wrong, advance flag honoured; complete endpoint awards Butterfly Points by difficulty (5 easy, 20 hard) and grants the 'hard' achievement (previously broken 'expert' key bug is now confirmed fixed); sessions/{uid} returns active+recent; stats/{uid} aggregates. Frontend: Games Hub shows Trivia tile WITHOUT a SOON badge and Daily Trivia row is tappable. /games/trivia hub renders instructions+SpeakButton, Daily Trivia card (10 mixed questions · 15 pts), Mixed + all 7 category chips, 4 difficulty rows with correct point values (5/10/20/35), and a Start button. Player loads with question + 4 choices, SpeakButton, 50/50 + Skip lifeline buttons (testIDs present). Completing all questions renders the results screen with testID='trivia-result' showing '<score> / <total>', '+N Butterfly Points' message, summary review, and CTA buttons. Two React Native Web style deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*) remain across the app (pre-existing).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (Pre-existing from iteration_1)
Console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. (Pre-existing)

Uses Alert.alert(...) confirmation which renders silently on react-native-web (no dialog appears in the Expo web preview). Works fine on native iOS/Android but on web the confirmation never appears so users tapping 50/50 from a browser see no effect. Reference: /app/frontend/app/games/trivia/player.tsx:218. Consider a custom Modal or skipping the confirmation on web.

action_items: (Optional) Replace Alert.alert confirmation for 50/50 with a custom Modal so the lifeline is usable on the Expo web preview (works fine on native).
(Pre-existing) Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and textShadow* -> textShadow across StyleSheet.create() blocks.
critical_code_review_comments: log_game_completion (server.py:742-747) now correctly grants 'hard' / 'nightmare' achievement keys matching ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS — legacy 'expert' key bug is fixed.
_trivia_strip_answer correctly removes both 'answer' and 'explain' fields from question payloads sent to the client (verified by automated tests).
trivia_daily seeds with year*10000+month*100+day so it is deterministic for the day, producing the same 10 question_ids on repeated calls.
seed_data_creation: None. Test runs use existing demo users (billdo, joycey, art, eil) via /api/auth/demo-login. Trivia sessions are created in db.trivia_sessions for those users but do not affect production-visible data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trivia backend + frontend fully verified. /app/backend/tests/test_trivia.py is the regression suite — run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported. The 'hard'/'nightmare' achievement granting code is at server.py:742-747; ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS does NOT contain an 'expert' key, so the previous bug (granting 'expert') would have silently no-ed out. Demo login: POST /api/auth/demo-login { username: 'maggie'|'frankie'|... }. Frontend player results testID is 'trivia-result'; lifeline testIDs are 'trivia-fifty' and 'trivia-skip'. Note Alert.alert is silent on web preview so 50/50 only works on native unless the main agent swaps to a custom Modal.
rca_of_issue: Previously log_game_completion attempted to grant achievement key 'expert' which did not exist in ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS, so _grant_achievement returned False without recording the achievement. The current code (server.py:742-747) explicitly grants 'hard' for difficulty=='hard' and 'nightmare' for difficulty=='nightmare', both of which exist in ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS. Automated test test_hard_full_score_awards_20_and_hard_achievement verifies a Hard trivia completion ends with 'hard' present in GET /api/games/stats/{uid} achievements and 'expert' absent.
